title: It's ok...material was more causual than expected
text: It's ok...material was more causual than expected. Couldn't find a cover for our sectional so went with 2 xlarge.. i recommend go bigger than suggested size otherwise whole couch isn't covered. Foam rolls do not really stay in place so constantly readjusting.  But protects couch & would like a smoother material.
